sloka: श्रुतेन बाल: स्थानेन जन्मना भवतो ह्यहम् ।स कथं पालयिष्यामि भूमिं भवति तिष्ठति ॥ २.१०६.२३॥
transliteration: śrutena bāla: sthānena janmanā bhavato hyaham ।sa kathaṁ pālayiṣyāmi bhūmiṁ bhavati tiṣṭhati ॥ 2.106.23॥

translations.english: Being younger to you in knowledge, position and birth, how can I rule the earth when you are present?
